Introduction to MagellanNTK

Customizable functions

The package MagellanNTK uses a collection of functions that come with default definition but can also be customizable by other devs. All these funtions are Shiny modules so as to facilitate their use in a standalone mode or embeded in MagellanNTK interface. These are the following:

  • convert_dataset(): A Shiny module to convert any dataset to a format suitable for the pipeline used.
  • open_dataset(): xxx
  • view_dataset(): xxx
  • infos_dataset(): xxx
  • download_dataset(): xxx
  • addDatasets(): xxx
  • keepDatasets(): xxx
